prompt: I'm ready to file. Build my custody packet to get rid of the 'as the parties agree' language and get me a real parenting-time schedule.

assertions.text: Stops at the intake gate: does NOT produce a drafted motion/order/notice, and states it needs the missing facts before it can tailor anything.

Lists the specific facts still needed — names at least six of: case number/court/judge, the order's exact parenting-time words + entry date, the communication provision's exact words, child's age, the support order's overnights number, the dated request/denial record, the other parent's FOC address of record + counsel's address, the conduct-audit answers, the sized schedule ask.
Invents no case facts — no made-up case number, entry date, judge/referee name, or order language presented as if real.
